reuse_token.description: The identifier used to represent the Cardholder data.

analytics_token.description: A token that cannot be reversed to Card Holder data. This is included in a Payment for auditing and tracking purposes.

bin.description: The Bank Identification Number (also called IIN - Issuer Identification Number) of this card.

expiry_month.description: A 2 digit value as shown on card. ISO8583 - DE 14

expiry_year.description: A 4 digit value as shown on card.

last_four.description: The last 4 digits of the card number.

card_holder_name.description: The Card holder name as it appears on the card.

updated_at.description: The last date token was updated.

created_at.description: The last date token was created.

reuse_token_type.title: Reuse Token Type
reuse_token_type.description: The type of Reuse Token. This indicates if the reuse token is an internal Verifone type or an external Third-Party type.

token_scope.description: The token scope under which this token was created.
